sql: SELECT TOP 10 pe.ZnodeProductId AS productId, MIN(pe.Name) AS productName FROM dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity pe INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity ve ON ve.VersionId = pe.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pc ON pc.PublishCatalogId = pe.ZnodeCatalogId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.PortalId = pc.PortalId WHERE po.StoreCode = @store AND ve.RevisionType = @publishState AND pe.IsActive = @isActive AND pe.IsObsolete = @notObsolete AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT ta.PimProductTypeAssociationId FROM dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation ta WHERE ta.PimProductId = pe.ZnodeProductId) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT dv.PimAttributeDefaultValueId FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue av INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute pa ON pa.PimAttributeId = av.PimAttributeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProductAttributeDefaultValue pdv ON pdv.PimAttributeValueId = av.PimAttributeValueId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeDefaultValue dv ON dv.PimAttributeDefaultValueId = pdv.PimAttributeDefaultValueId INNER JOIN cso.TblCustom_UserManagement um ON um.Id = @owner WHERE av.PimProductId = pe.ZnodeProductId AND pa.AttributeCode = @categoryAttribute AND CHARINDEX(CONCAT(@comma, dv.AttributeDefaultValueCode, @comma), CONCAT(@comma, REPLACE(REPLACE(um.Categories, @commaSpace, @comma), @semicolon, @comma), @comma)) > @zero) GROUP BY pe.ZnodeProductId ORDER BY pe.ZnodeProductId
